scope: Post-evaluation diagnostic; no model or prediction changes

null_control.interpretation: Same linear smoother gives exactly additive means; output scaling cancels. Joint calibrated intervals need not be equal.

budget_interpretation: Same physical-query budget, not same total cost; posthoc total is development-median solver estimate plus actual fits, not wall-clock re-execution
final_audit_interpretation: Uniform logical one-reference audit fee, not a fresh solver run; cache-aware alternative reported
